plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch adjustment + enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 kidney samples (6 treated, 6 control) processed in two balanced batches. Salmon-derived raw gene counts require DESeq2 with a design of ~batch+condition to remove the known batch effect (each batch holds both conditions, so it is not confounded) while testing the condition contrast. Standard workflow: sample-structure QC to confirm no unexpected outliers/batch drift beyond the modeled batch term, minimal low-count pre-filter, DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage of the condition log2 fold change, BH-adjusted results at alpha 0.05, followed by over-representation enrichment (the knowledge service flags fgsea preranked GSEA as not permitted for this situation and requires ORA with an explicit universe instead) against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways human gene sets available in the reference store, and a final consolidated report with fit diagnostics and reproducibility record.
